Squawk sprays DM with her experimental empathy gas in the hope that he will find it easier to care about other people. The newly empathetic DM is a changed mouse! One who seems to think breaking the Baron out of prison is a great idea.

channel.name: CBBC UK
channel.title: Super Happy Magic Forest
channel.desc: Mr Friendlyface is acting very strangely indeed. He refuses to stamp any of Admin Bunny?s documents, keeps getting distracted by butterflies, and seems oddly happy! The heroes are extremely suspicious and decide that someone must have swapped him with a doppelganger. Now they must quest to find out where the real Friendlyface is and get him back before the forest descends into total chaos.

channel.name: CBBC UK
channel.title: Boy Girl Dog Cat Mouse Cheese
channel.desc: Dog decides to show the family that he can be as tough as the wolves they are watching on TV. He joins a gang of street dogs and soon becomes leader of the pack. Meanwhile, the rest of the kids worry when Dog doesn?t come home and go out looking for him. However, they find that he is now too cool to be part of the 'old' family - until he is forced to make a choice between loyalty to the pack and loyalty to his best friend Boy.

channel.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings

channel.name: CBBC UK
channel.title: Duck and Frog
channel.desc: Duck is a tour guide at a grand stately home, and Frog thinks it's so nice that he decides to move in. When he gets annoyed by the tourists, Frog dresses up as a ghost to scare them off.

channel.name: CBBC UK
channel.title: Odd Squad
channel.desc: An international high-tech organisation run by kids, which investigates all things strange, weird and, most importantly, odd.

channel.title: Shark Bites

channel.desc: Learn how to use subordinating conjunctions.

channel.title: Hey You What If?

channel.name: CBBC UK
channel.title: Horrible Histories
channel.desc: The Vikings launch their advert for We Sell Any Monk, Queen Elizabeth I surprises her court with some very odd laws, the sacrifice-obsessed Aztec priests sing their gruesome disco song, plus the Roman equivalent of text messaging.

channel.name: CBBC UK
channel.title: Deadly 60
channel.desc: Steve Backshall and his long-suffering crew return for more deadly encounters with animals hoping to earn a place on his hallowed Deadly 60 list. Steve Backshall travels to Indonesia in search of three very different reptiles to add to his list of 60 deadly predators. He and his crew have a nerve-racking close encounter when they are chased by a group of ravenous, three-metre-long komodo dragons, the world's largest venomous lizards! Steve also demonstrates the incredible gliding technique of a tiny flying lizard and heads out on a nocturnal hunt for the beautiful but lethal green pit viper.

channel.name: CBBC UK
channel.title: Operation Ouch!
channel.desc: The doctors get competitive in a race to reveal what happens when blood vessels get blocked, Dr Xand goes for some physiotherapy and Dr Chris is out with the emergency services helping a man with chest pain. Meanwhile, in accident and emergency, one patient has hurt his neck playing rugby and another has cut his head being a superhero.

channel.name: CBBC UK
channel.title: Go Get Arty
channel.desc: It's kids v parents! The Kwapongs make smashable pinatas and remix classic art in Liverpool. Maisie Adam draws a footballing narwhal, and an illusion artist makes her face vanish.

channel.name: CBBC UK
channel.title: Out of This World
channel.desc: In this episode, Dr Maggie reveals the game changers of space missions and spacecraft, from the space shuttle to the Hubble Space Telescope, that have transformed our lives on Earth and beyond. Dr Maggie?s star guest is Nasa astronaut Kathy Sullivan, who is a game changer herself. She flew in the space shuttle three times, delivered Hubble into orbit and was the first American woman to walk in space! Dr Maggie also counts down the Top 5 Most Expensive Missions and all your space questions are answered in Ask Maggie. Buckle up, it?s time to go Out of This World.

channel.name: CBBC UK
channel.title: The Dengineers
channel.desc: Siblings Nethuni and Abheetha are obsessed with optical illusions and want a den where they can work together to create new tricks to dazzle their friends.

Meanwhile, Bactrian camels Mo and Navas display some serious suction with their super-slurping, and Cletus the dwarf crocodile arrives at the zoo ready to flex his pecs. Aaron reveals the mighty powers of the cockroach, and the brothers take a trip to Uganda to help a conservation project caring for orphaned chimpanzees.

channel.title: Peppa Pig

channel.title: Peppa Pig

channel.title: Peppa Pig
channel.desc: Today is Mandy Mouse's birthday, and as a special treat, Mandy is going to Cheese World with her friends. It is the most fun ever.

channel.title: Peppa Pig
